surface: template_payload.resolve_conflict_plan, template_payload_manifest path_rules, import-payload conservative apply
summary: Conservative `gh plate import-payload` no longer overwrites customized `.github/labels.yml`, issue templates, or `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`; differing files are reported as conflicts and left untouched (#1250).
migration_impact: Adopters upgrading with `--strategy conservative` keep local label taxonomy and GitHub templates when content differs from the payload. Use `--strategy safe` when intentionally refreshing PLATE taxonomy/templates, or `--strategy force` for a deliberate full overwrite.
migration_guidance: After pinning plate-core, run `gh plate import-payload --dry-run --strategy conservative --json` and resolve any new conflicts before `--apply`.
To refresh labels/templates from upstream, use `--strategy safe` (path_rules overwrite) or merge manually — not conservative.
agent_notes: Manifest `on_conflict: overwrite` applies to safe/force only; conservative always maps differing existing files to conflict.
